entries: We should get to the library. Maybe we can come back for this guy later.
我们该去图书馆了。也许回头再来接这位。
I do not think we can continue this way. At least we have the library key now.
这样下去恐怕走不通。至少现在我们有了图书馆的钥匙。
He'd win a staring contest for sure.
If ever turn stone, make head into hammer. Great honor.
要是哪天变成石头，把头做成锤子。无上荣耀。
I am not sure I would consider that an honor.
我可不确定那算得上荣耀。
As long as I do not have to carry him.
我感到了什么……里面有生命。
He could be a village centerpiece.
他大可以当村子的中心摆设。
I get the feeling he is watching us.
我总觉得他在看着我们。
This man must have been one of the librarian's companions.
这个人一定是那位图书管理员，当年的同伴之一。
Poor sap looks like he went down fighting. I can respect that.
可怜的家伙，看样子是战死的。我敬重这样的人。
Maybe he is still in there somewhere.
也许他还在里面的某个地方。
